flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate edged up slightly in Polymarket odds, with the party still the market's favourite. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Pete Ricketts gained sharply, while in [[Michigan]] the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed also improved by a sizable margin. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Adam Hamilton lost a moderate amount of ground in what the market still sees as a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Jim Pillen saw a sizable improvement in Polymarket odds, while in [[Texas]] the Republican Greg Abbott also strengthened moderately. In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained ground in a race the market lists as a predicted flip. Over in Florida, the Republican Byron Donalds slipped a little in the market's view.
summaries.house: Democrats remain the favoured party to win control of the House, and Polymarket odds for them edged up slightly today. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp drop in chances against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]], the Republican Dan Green slipped by a sizable amount against the Democrat Darren Soto, and the market still lists the district as a predicted flip. The projected seat count moved to 238-197, down from 239-196, with the result still that Democrats gain control.
